companyDescription: Optical interposer photonics · POET Infinity and Blazar optical engines for AI datacenter interconnect — now funded through the ramp with $830M+ on the balance sheet
priceNote: Live price Aug 13 07:49, +3.26% today. Prior turbo report was written Jul 2 at $9.79 — 42 days old, the oldest on the board, and -9.4% drift. Its catalysts were all dated Q2 2026 or earlier, so the pick had gone post-stage and was still ranked as if its events were ahead.
summary: ⚠️ EVENTS RESOLVED — this replaces a Jul 2 report whose catalysts (Lessengers 1.6T samples, LITEON collaboration, Lumilens scale-up) were all dated Q2 2026 or vaguer, and have since passed or dissolved into ongoing execution. Q2 2026 results came out Aug 10. What changed most is the balance sheet: POET disclosed more than $830M in cash and investments as of June, against a ~$1.6B market cap — roughly half the company is cash, which removes the financing risk that defines most picks in this lane. Operationally it guides to over 30,000 optical engines shipped in 2026 and capacity up to 1 million units per month by end-2027. The offset is that sell-side targets sit near $7.00, below the live $8.87, so the upside case is a ramp-execution bet rather than a consensus gap. Base re-derived to +35% from the stale +65%.
